name: minimal-mono-design
description: Minimal monochrome design system — Geist Mono typography, light/dark/system theme via CSS custom properties with FOUC-free init, 640px centered column layout, terminal-styled install boxes with copy-to-tick cross-fade, theme toggle, and prose-md README rendering. Default stack: Astro + Tailwind 4. Explicit guidance for Next.js (App Router), plain HTML/CSS, and any CSS-based framework.
